_readme: Site settings. Edit, then run: python3 build.py
name: Archive 88
tagline: Curated pieces, made in limited runs
_tagline_note: The two lines from the logo. Used in the page title, the footer and the gift card.
description: Archive 88 is a small collection of outdoor clothing, chosen piece by piece and made in limited runs. Wool, wax and cotton, cut to be worn for years. Est. 1988.

home._note: Every word and picture on the homepage. Images live in assets/img/. Keep hero_title to two short lines and hero_lead under 20 words.
home.hero_lead: Outdoor clothing in wool, wax and cotton. Chosen one piece at a time since 1988.
home.statement: Archive 88 is a small collection, chosen piece by piece. Each style is made in a limited run, in cloth that gets better with wear, and given its own number in the archive.

stories.alt: Tall pines over a path that leads down to the sea.
stories.title: Built for weather
stories.text: Coats and jackets in wool, wax and gabardine, cut with room for a layer underneath.

stories.alt: Two people walking a forest path toward the water.
stories.title: Knitwear, spun slow
stories.text: Merino, lambswool and cashmere from mills that have been spinning for generations.

banner.title: Made to be worn often
banner.text: Wear it in the rain, on the coast, on the long way round. If something gives, send it back and we will mend it.

_shopify_domain_note: Set to your-store.myshopify.com and fill shopify_variant_ids in catalog.json to send the bag to Shopify checkout.
announcements: Free UK delivery on orders over £150
Free 30-day returns, collected from your door
Gift cards, sent by email or post
_announcements_note: Rotating bar above the header: [message, link text, link]. Links are relative to the site root.

gift_cards._note: SAMPLE terms: check validity period and wording against your policy before launch. shopify_variant_ids: {"email/100": 123, "post/100": 456} enables checkout handoff.
gift_cards.post_note: Printed on heavy card in a woven envelope. Free UK postage, dispatched in 1 to 2 working days.
gift_cards.email_note: Arrives in their inbox straight away, or on a date you choose.
gift_cards.terms: Spend online on anything in the archive. Use it in one go or over several orders.

social._note: PLACEHOLDER handles. Replace with the real profiles.

business._note: PLACEHOLDER details, safe to publish while testing: the phone number is from Ofcom's range reserved for TV and film (020 7946 0xxx), the email uses the reserved .example domain, and the address, company and VAT numbers are fictional. Replace all of them before launch: UK distance-selling rules require your real trading name, a geographic address and a way to contact you.

shipping_text: Dispatched within 1 to 2 working days, tracked. UK delivery 1 to 3 working days: free on orders over £150, otherwise £5. International rates are shown at checkout.
_shipping_text_note: PLACEHOLDER wording. Replace with your real rates and times.
_legal_reviewed_note: Set to true once a solicitor has checked Privacy and Terms; it removes the 'Draft' note on those pages.
